rule.title: Normalized High-Dimensional Cosine Similarity Search
rule.statement: pgvector similarity search must compute Cosine Distance (<=> operator) against normalized 3,072-dimensional embedding vectors.
rule.rationale: Cosine similarity measures angular semantic direction independently of document chunk length, ensuring short definitions match long explanations accurately.
rule.implementation_guidance: Use SELECT ... ORDER BY embedding <=> query_vector LIMIT topK with an IVFFlat or HNSW index on the embedding column.

forbidden.example: Using Euclidean distance (<->) on unnormalized embedding vectors of variable text lengths.

preferred.example: SELECT id, content, 1 - (embedding <=> $1) AS score FROM document_chunks WHERE user_id = $2 ORDER BY embedding <=> $1 LIMIT 8;

source.chapter: Chapter 4: Vector Indexing and Distance Metrics
source.evidence_quote: Cosine similarity is the preferred distance metric for semantic text embeddings as it evaluates the cosine of the angle between vectors, normalizing for document length.
